title: Field-only photometric distillation with mask-restricted color and silhouette supervision on Janelle frame 00008
question: Trained only from decoded compact 2D Gaussian fields, their cameras and the packed training alpha, with color supervised inside the mask and a silhouette term outside, does a random-initialized 3DGS match photograph supervision inside held-out masks without more floaters, and does a teacher fitted without mask containment beat the mask-contained teacher?
hypothesis: H1: no_boundary/random/masked-silhouette is within 0.5 dB held-out foreground PSNR and 0.02 masked-crop LPIPS of photographs/random/masked-silhouette in every paired seed, with outside-mask alpha mass at most 0.005 above it. H2: no_boundary beats mask_contained by at least 0.2 dB foreground PSNR in every paired seed without higher outside-mask alpha mass. H3 (descriptive): random initialization is not worse than the alpha visual hull by more than 0.5 dB. H4 (descriptive): the silhouette objective lowers outside-mask alpha mass relative to the premultiplied-black objective.
claim_boundary: Development screen on one previously outcome-exposed frame (RTGS-021/024 used it), one train/held-out split, three paired seeds and one fixed 8000-step budget at downscale 8. Packed training alpha is mask-derived and is used for supervision and the hull; this is field-plus-silhouette, not strictly Gaussian-only reconstruction. Held-out photographs and masks are evaluation-only. no_boundary retains 5000-8592 Gaussians per view versus 11000 for mask_contained and gaussianimage, and uses a different topology schedule outcome, so H2 compares teacher families, not containment alone. No default, SOTA, generalization, physical-geometry or speed claim. Before protocol review, a non-protocol driver smoke on training views only exposed training-view teacher fidelity to the Driver; no reconstruction or held-out outcome was observed and no threshold changed afterwards.

stages.label: Prepare targets
stages.purpose: Decode training compact views with rtgs.data.field_targets (CUDA index, CPU-index parity on fixed sites) and prepare photograph targets for the control arms only; training views only.

stages.label: Initialization
stages.purpose: Seeded random or packed-alpha visual hull initialization, saved once per (initializer, target family, seed) and digest-checked in the fitting worker.

stages.label: 3DGS fitting
stages.purpose: Identical gsplat Trainer, density schedule and budget; only target family, initializer and mask objective vary.

stages.label: Final reporting
stages.purpose: Evaluate fixed final models on held-out photographs inside held-out masks, plus outside-mask alpha for floaters.

comparators.label: no_boundary / random / masked+silhouette
comparators.purpose: Primary field-only main-path cell: teacher fitted with masked L2 and no containment.

comparators.label: no_boundary / alpha hull / masked+silhouette
comparators.purpose: H3: initializer effect with the same teacher and objective.

comparators.label: no_boundary / random / premultiplied black
comparators.purpose: H4: removes the mask-restricted color and silhouette terms; field times packed alpha on black, use_masks=False.

comparators.label: mask_contained / random / masked+silhouette
comparators.purpose: H2: hard mask-contained teacher family under the primary objective.

comparators.label: gaussianimage / random / masked+silhouette
comparators.purpose: Second uncontained teacher family (11000/view, additive) under the primary objective.

comparators.label: photographs / random / masked+silhouette
comparators.purpose: H1 reference: photograph supervision with the identical initializer, mask and trainer.

primary_metrics.label: Held-out foreground PSNR
primary_metrics.aggregation: Squared RGB error of the black-background render against the held-out photograph over the fixed held-out binary mask only, -10log10 per view; mean of the four views per seed; report every view, seed and paired delta.

primary_metrics.label: Held-out masked-crop LPIPS
primary_metrics.aggregation: AlexNet LPIPS(normalize=True) on render and photograph both multiplied by the held-out mask, cropped to the mask bounding box padded 8 px; per-view mean per seed.

primary_metrics.label: Held-out outside-mask alpha mass
primary_metrics.aggregation: Mean rendered alpha over pixels outside the held-out mask dilated by 3 output pixels; per-view mean per seed. Floater/halo measure; no color is evaluated outside the mask.

primary_metrics.label: Held-out floater pixel fraction
primary_metrics.aggregation: Fraction of pixels outside the 3-pixel-dilated held-out mask with rendered alpha >= 0.5; per-view mean per seed.

primary_metrics.label: Held-out interior coverage
primary_metrics.aggregation: Mean rendered alpha inside the held-out mask eroded by 3 output pixels; per-view mean per seed.

resource_protocol.scope: Fresh process per fitting cell including loading and final save; target decoding and evaluation timed separately. Local desktop GPU; descriptive only.
resource_protocol.aggregation: All three paired seeds retained; no speed inference.

preprocessing.target_operator: Field targets: rtgs.data.field_targets.decode_compact_view(downscale=8, supersample=2): box average of four clamped field queries at edge-origin quarter offsets; zero outside the fit window. Photograph targets: same four sites, bilinear grid_sample(align_corners=False) of the undistorted full-resolution photograph, clamped. Field colors outside the training mask are never supervised because the Trainer composites the target with a random background outside the mask.
preprocessing.training_masks: All arms: packed training alpha from the no_boundary compact views, decode_alpha_grid(downscale=8, supersample=2) as a soft fraction. The packed crops are required to equal the thresholded lossless source masks; this equality is checked once for the photograph arms, which otherwise use the identical tensor.
preprocessing.premultiplied_arm: nb_rand_pm target = decoded field color times the same soft training alpha, black outside; use_masks=False, random_background=False.
preprocessing.teacher_qualification: Report, not gate: mean training-view foreground PSNR of each decoded field family against identically sampled photographs inside the training mask.
preprocessing.decoder_parity: Per training view and field family: 512 in-window sites from torch.Generator seed 926100 + training-view index; CPU index vs reference scan max abs <= 1e-5 and CUDA vs CPU index <= 2e-5, else abort before fitting.

initialization.bounds: rtgs.data.calibrated._object_bounds on the 22 downscale-8 training cameras and their soft packed training alpha thresholded at 0.5; extent is the full diameter; identical in every cell.
initialization.random: 20000 points uniform in the ball of radius 0.5 x extent about the bound center (float64 draws from the paired seed), isotropic scale equal to the mean nearest-neighbour distance, opacity 0.1, colour 0.5 gray.
initialization.alpha_hull: Packed-alpha visual hull on a 128^3 grid over the bound cube: voxels whose center projects in-frame with soft alpha >= 0.5 in every training view; up to 20000 shell voxels chosen by paired seed; isotropic scale one voxel; opacity 0.1; colour = mean of the arm's own training targets sampled at the projected center (field arms: decoded fields; photograph arms: photographs). Abort if fewer than 1000 voxels or the hull touches a cube face.
initialization.sharing: The random initialization is byte-identical across all random cells of one seed; the hull geometry is identical across hull cells of one seed and differs only in colour by target family. The hull shell on this frame is smaller than n_points (a non-protocol training-view smoke found 7740 shell voxels), so hull cells start with fewer Gaussians than random cells; H3 therefore compares initializers including their initial count and remains descriptive.

training.other_defaults: TrainConfig/DensityConfig defaults at the frozen source, preserved in resolved_training_configs.

scoring.evaluation_grid: Held-out cameras at downscale 8; held-out photograph and mask sampled with the same four-site operator; mask binarized at 0.5 of the averaged samples.
scoring.foreground: As primary_metrics.foreground_psnr; no colour outside the mask.
scoring.alpha: Rendered alpha from the same gsplat render; dilation/erosion are 3-output-pixel square structuring elements.
scoring.diagnostic_only: Foreground PSNR against the decoded held-out field of the arm's own family inside the held-out mask (field consistency); full-canvas metrics are not computed because the room background is unmodelled.
scoring.selection: Final 8000-step models only; no held-out selection. Save held-out comparison PNGs for every cell and fixed orbit previews.

decision_policy.g0_photo_reference: ph_rand_ms foreground PSNR >= 24.0 dB in every seed and recognizable complete subject in the independent visual audit. If it fails, H1/H2 are reported as inconclusive.
decision_policy.h1_main_path: Pass iff for every paired seed: nb_rand_ms foreground PSNR >= ph_rand_ms - 0.5 dB, crop LPIPS <= ph_rand_ms + 0.02, outside_alpha_mass <= ph_rand_ms + 0.005.
decision_policy.h2_teacher_containment: Pass iff for every paired seed nb_rand_ms foreground PSNR >= mc_rand_ms + 0.2 dB and outside_alpha_mass <= mc_rand_ms + 0.005; reverse inequality in every seed rejects; otherwise inconclusive. Count confound stated in claim_boundary.
decision_policy.h3_h4: Descriptive with paired deltas; no pass/fail promotion.
decision_policy.consequence: A pass keeps the RTGS-025 main path and selects the uncontained teacher family for the next task; no default promotion from this development screen.
decision_policy.stopping: Fixed final 8000 steps; no metric-based early stopping. Abort a cell on non-finite values, CUDA OOM or 3600 s wall; preserve the failure and completed cells; stop the matrix on the first execution failure.

execution_order.warmup: One disposable 32x32 two-Gaussian forward/backward CUDA render per fresh fitting worker, excluded from reported iterations.

execution_controls.rng_policy: After warmup, seed Python random, NumPy, torch CPU and all CUDA generators with the paired seed; CUDA bitwise determinism is not assumed.

source_lifecycle: Development init-run --development; archive the exact executed source under the canonical run before the first cell; no source mutation during execution.
